name: How do you ensure grab bars and wall supports are properly secured?

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure grab bars and wall supports are properly secured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grab bars must never be secured with standard drywall anchors alone; they require solid wood backing inside the wall to ensure user safety. During a bathroom remodel, HH Remodeling installs horizontal solid wood blocking between studs before hanging moisture-resistant drywall, cement board, and tile. If work is done on an existing finished wall without a full tear-out, bars are mounted directly into existing wall studs using heavy-duty, corrosion-resistant structural fasteners.
acceptedAnswer.description: Safety bars are secured either by framing solid horizontal wood blocking between wall studs during renovation or by mounting directly into existing studs with heavy-duty fasteners.
